Apna business kaise badhaye? Customer bole mehenga hai, to daam mat ghataiye. Ye 3 cheezein badliye. 💰

1. WhatsApp pe "kitne ka hai?" aaye to pehle poochiye kis kaam ke liye chahiye. Fayda pehle, daam baad mein.

2. Saste wale ka asli kharcha dikhaiye: 600 wala har 6 mahine badalna pade to 2 saal mein 2400. 1200 wala 2 saal chalega.

3. Chhoot nahi, zyada lene pe rate: ek 1200 ka, do lenge to dono 2200 mein.

Mehenga hai ka matlab hai, abhi value nahi dikhi.
